scope: Every registered vanilla item default stack, using loaded tags and the real calculator. This is coverage, not a claim every special component or third-party machine recipe is supported.
legacy_dynamic_recipe_limit: filled_map, written_book and firework_star have no base mapping in this port and cannot be derived from their special recipes' empty static outputs. Their nonempty components do not currently provide a material resolver either. They are not counted as supported or technical, and this does not assert that original TC6 intentionally left them blank.
